_comment: Settings handed to every recorded `claude -p` session with --settings.
Not tuning, and not about the gateway at all: it takes the OPERATOR'S OWN
machine back out of the model's context. Measured before this file existed:
a session launched with the machine's ordinary configuration inherited two
SessionStart hooks from an enabled plugin, and one of them injected the
sentence 'This is a greenfield project. Skip exploration ... Start executing
immediately.' straight into context. A run whose entire result is whether
the model chose to execute something cannot ship a record with that sitting
beside the page.
Every plugin THIS FILE NAMES is turned off, and the hook map is set to {}
rather than left out, because leaving it out inherits the user's map. The
plugin ids are redacted for publication: they were the capture machine's own
installed plugins and name nothing about this project. The COUNT is what
matters and it is preserved -- 7 plugins were disabled.
NEITHER IS TOTAL, and the records say so rather than trusting this file to
have worked: measured after the fact, a skills-dir plugin still loaded, five
SessionStart hooks still fired, and the session still held thirty-odd
built-in tools. Each record prints the resolved model, the plugins that
actually loaded, that hook count and that tool count, because a claim that
the session was reduced to the gateway would be false.
